text: Create a small altar in your home. It can be a non-religious but sacred place for you. Put there objects that connect you with the Higher: a beautiful crystal, a photograph of a sunset, a feather found on a walk... That is, not just an icon bought in a church shop, but objects each of which is connected with a real memory of a moment in your life when you clearly felt the closeness of God or the most elevated states. This island of holiness will become a wonderful place for your prayer and attunement to high vibrations.
